gizmo.title: Furitaanka qalab dibadeed
gizmo.description: Block fura qalab waxbarasho dibadeed daaqad cusub ama bogga, sida link caadi ah ama codsi galitaan LTI 1.3 ah.

configure.title: Cinwaan
configure.description: Magaca qalabka. Wuxuu ka muuqdaa madaxa iyo badhanka.

configure.title: Sharraxaad
configure.description: Waxa ardaydu ku sameeyaan qalabka, oo ka muuqda badhanka korkiisa.

configure.title: URL-ka furitaanka
configure.description: Cinwaanka qalabka. Waa inuu noqdaa cinwaan buuxa oo ku bilaabma https:// ama http://.

configure.title: Ku fur
configure.description: Daaqad cusub waxay la shaqaysaa qalab kasta. Boggan wuxuu la shaqeeyaa oo keliya qalabka oggol in lagu muujiyo goob kale gudaheeda.

advanced.title: URL-ka galitaanka LTI
advanced.description: LTI 1.3 oo keliya: cinwaanka bilowga galitaanka qalabka. Isaga, client ID iyo deployment ID, badhanku wuxuu diraa codsi galitaan LTI halkii uu furi lahaa link caadi ah. Dhammaystirka furitaanku wuxuu u baahan yahay adeegga LTI ee goobtan.

advanced.title: LTI client ID
advanced.description: Client ID-ga qalabku siiyay goobtan. Aqoonsi guud, ma aha sir: weligaa halkan ha gelin furayaal ama siro.

advanced.title: LTI deployment ID
advanced.description: Deployment ID-ga qalabku siiyay goobtan. Aqoonsi guud, ma aha sir.

advanced.title: LTI issuer
advanced.description: Cinwaanka goobtan ku aqoonsiiya qalabka. Ka tag madhan si aad u isticmaasho cinwaanka goobta boggu ku yaal.

advanced.title: Dhererka bogga
advanced.description: Dhererka qalabka marka uu ku furmo boggan, pixel ahaan (200 ilaa 2000).

advanced.title: Midabka xoojinta
advanced.description: Midabka chip-ka madaxa iyo badhanka. Ka tag madhan si aad u raacdo theme-ka.

developer.title: Tilmaanta galitaanka LTI
developer.description: Qiime qarsoon oo adeegga LTI ee goobtan u isticmaalo aqoonsiga ardayga. Badanaa goobta ayaa ku bixisa dhacdada lti-launch-request halkii halkan lagu kaydin lahaa. Weligiis ma aha furaha sirta ama fure.

developer.title: Tilmaanta fariinta LTI
developer.description: Qiime qarsoon oo adeegga LTI ee goobtan u isticmaalo aqoonsiga furitaankan. Badanaa goobta ayaa bixisa halkii halkan lagu kaydin lahaa.
